signals.pr_note: Software Developer on CSOL with strong 189/190 visa outcomes. ICT professionals consistently in top invitation rounds.
signals.ai_note: AI coding assistants are reshaping entry-level roles. Senior architects and systems designers remain in demand.

signals.pr_note: Data Analyst roles appear on CSOL. AI/ML specialisations strengthen visa applications.
signals.ai_note: AI augments analytics work. Demand for AI-literate data professionals is growing faster than traditional BI roles.

signals.pr_note: ICT Security Specialist on CSOL with national shortage. Critical infrastructure demand drives strong PR outcomes.
signals.ai_note: Cyber threats grow with AI but defenders are equally in demand. Low AI displacement risk.

representative_occupations.label: Cyber Security Advice and Assessment Specialist
representative_occupations.labelKo: Cyber Security Advice and Assessment Specialist

signals.pr_note: Registered Nurse is one of the strongest PR pathways. National shortage across all states. High 189/190 invitation rates.
signals.ai_note: Nursing is fundamentally human-centred care. AI assists documentation but cannot replace clinical practice.

signals.pr_note: Aged care workers in critical national shortage. Direct pathway to PR via 482→186 and state nomination.
signals.ai_note: Care work is hands-on and emotionally complex. Minimal AI displacement risk.

signals.pr_note: Physiotherapy and OT on CSOL. Strong employment outcomes and state nomination pathways.
signals.ai_note: Allied health relies on physical assessment and manual therapy. Low AI exposure.

representative_occupations.label: Oral Health Therapist or Dental Therapist
representative_occupations.labelKo: Oral Health Therapist or Dental Therapist

signals.pr_note: Engineering professionals on CSOL. Broad skill set applicable across industries.
signals.ai_note: CAD and simulation tools are increasingly AI-assisted but design judgement remains human.

signals.pr_note: Civil Engineer on CSOL with shortage. Infrastructure boom drives demand. Strong 189/190 outcomes.
signals.ai_note: Structural analysis software is AI-enhanced but site management and design judgment remain human.

signals.pr_note: Mechanical Engineer on CSOL. Defence and manufacturing sectors drive demand.
signals.ai_note: CAD/CAM and simulation tools are increasingly automated but engineering judgment remains essential.

signals.pr_note: Mining Engineer on CSOL with national shortage. Western Australia and Queensland drive demand. Very strong salary signals.
signals.ai_note: Autonomous mining equipment is growing but oversight, planning and safety roles remain human.

signals.pr_note: Business Analyst roles on CSOL. Strong demand in financial services and consulting.
signals.ai_note: AI automates routine analysis. Strategic advisory and stakeholder management remain human.

signals.pr_note: Accountant on CSOL. CPA/CA qualification strengthens PR application. Moderate shortage.
signals.ai_note: AI and automation are transforming routine accounting. Advisory and forensic roles remain stable.

signals.pr_note: Solicitor on CSOL. Australian legal qualification is highly regarded. PR pathway through 189/190 for experienced lawyers.
signals.ai_note: Legal research and document review are increasingly AI-assisted. Court advocacy and client counselling remain human.

signals.pr_note: Early Childhood Teacher on CSOL with national shortage. Strong demand across all states.
signals.ai_note: Early childhood education is fundamentally relationship-based. Very low AI exposure.

signals.pr_note: Primary and Secondary Teachers on CSOL with national shortage. Strong state nomination pathways.
signals.ai_note: Teaching requires emotional intelligence, classroom management and mentoring. Minimal AI displacement.

signals.pr_note: Social Worker on CSOL. Community services sector has persistent national shortage.
signals.ai_note: Social work requires empathy, advocacy and crisis intervention. Minimal AI displacement.

signals.pr_note: Sport and fitness roles have limited PR pathways. Some coaching roles on shortage list regionally.
signals.ai_note: Physical coaching and personal training are inherently human. Minimal AI risk.

signals.pr_note: Carpenter in critical national shortage. One of the strongest trade PR pathways via 189/190/491.
signals.ai_note: Hands-on construction work is not automatable. Strong long-term demand.

signals.pr_note: Wall and Floor Tiler in national shortage. Strong trade PR pathway.
signals.ai_note: Manual trade requiring dexterity and judgement. Not automatable.

signals.pr_note: Electrician in critical national shortage. One of the highest-demand trades. Excellent PR outcomes.
signals.ai_note: Electrical installation requires physical presence and safety certification. Not automatable.

signals.pr_note: Plumber in critical national shortage. Strong trade PR pathway across all states.
signals.ai_note: Plumbing requires on-site physical work in varied environments. Not automatable.

signals.pr_note: Welder in national shortage. Mining and construction sectors drive demand.
signals.ai_note: Welding requires manual skill and certification. Robotic welding exists but field work remains human.

signals.pr_note: Bricklayer in national shortage. Construction boom drives demand. Strong trade PR pathway.
signals.ai_note: Bricklaying is a physical trade requiring site presence. Not automatable.

signals.pr_note: Air Conditioning Mechanic in national shortage. Strong demand across all states.
signals.ai_note: HVAC installation and repair requires physical presence. Growing demand with climate change.

signals.pr_note: Architect on CSOL. Design skills are valued but employment is project-dependent.
signals.ai_note: Generative AI is beginning to assist with design concepts. Creative vision remains human.

signals.pr_note: Design roles have moderate PR pathways. Stronger outcomes for UX/UI with tech company sponsorship.
signals.ai_note: AI image generation and design tools are rapidly evolving. Senior creative direction remains more stable.

signals.pr_note: Limited direct PR pathways for photography/film. May qualify through broader media category.
signals.ai_note: AI is entering video production and photography. Creative direction and storytelling remain human.

signals.pr_note: Environmental Scientist on CSOL. Climate policy drives growing demand.
signals.ai_note: Field research and environmental assessment require physical presence and expert judgement.

signals.pr_note: Agricultural Scientist on CSOL. Regional demand is strong. 491 visa pathway available.
signals.ai_note: Agricultural science combines field work with lab analysis. Low AI displacement.

signals.pr_note: Veterinarian on CSOL. National shortage. Strong demand in regional areas.
signals.ai_note: Veterinary medicine requires hands-on animal care and clinical judgement.

signals.pr_note: Hotel Manager roles appear on CSOL but outcomes vary. Stronger with multi-year experience.
signals.ai_note: AI handles bookings and operations. Guest experience management remains human.

signals.pr_note: Cook and Baker in national shortage. Certificate III pathway is fast. Strong 482/186 outcomes.
signals.ai_note: Commercial cookery is a hands-on craft. Automated kitchens exist but skilled chefs remain essential.

signals.pr_note: Beauty Therapist and Hairdresser in national shortage. Certificate III pathway. Growing demand.
signals.ai_note: Beauty therapy requires physical skill and client interaction. Very low AI displacement.

signals.pr_note: Motor Mechanic in national shortage. Strong trade PR pathway across all states.
signals.ai_note: Vehicle diagnostics increasingly digital but physical repair remains essential.

signals.pr_note: Pilot has moderate PR pathways. High training cost but strong long-term demand.
signals.ai_note: Autonomous aircraft are decades away. Pilot demand remains strong with aviation growth.

signals.pr_note: Marine Engineer and Deck Officer in national shortage. Strong demand in port cities.
signals.ai_note: Maritime operations require physical presence and safety certification. Not automatable.
